scope: Original bounded cloud CPU norm/residual and RoPE semantic fixtures
not_validated: allocator peak memory or storage release
FP16/mixed RoPE custom-kernel equivalence (reference fallback only)
full training quality or challenge numerical gates
performance graph points or own-kernel share

details.decision: Frozen FP32 standalone norm needs the actual staged derivative for these exact CPU results. Reject universal compact-formula, FP16-saved-input, or reconstructed-input equivalence.

Native frozen norm already saves only x/r/w storage. Deduplicating five references to three is not a storage saving; recomputing r removes only its tiny referenced storage in this toy inventory and adds unmeasured work.

Standalone norm exactness does not establish residual-fusion exactness. Native graph branch accumulation can change 0 into 1 under regrouping; retain both outputs, alias handling, version checks and branch-order validation.

Split-half pair adjoints match the tested FP32 strided/broadcast/unequal-head contracts. Preserve actual output strides and unused-gradient None semantics; this is not runtime Qwen dtype or CUDA evidence.

Native frozen-coefficient RoPE already saves cos/sin, not q/k. Four-to-two saved references is no unique-storage saving. Keep FP16/mixed/trainable-coefficient cases on reference until separately validated.

Reject interleaved rotation and generic inverse-RoPE adjoint assumptions. FP32 contraction can change valid split-half/trig outputs; preserve multiply/add rounding unless separately accepted by actual gates.
